svg.aria-label: Tier 0 through Tier 3 LLM trust ladder for regulated finance
svg.title: Tier 0 through Tier 3 LLM trust ladder for regulated finance
svg.desc: Pyramid-like vertical ladder with four tiers stacked from bottom (Tier 0, no LLM, deterministic) to top (Tier 3, customer-facing with guardrails). Each tier shows representative use case, human-review posture, and example deployment. Promotion-gate arrows on the right side show what a model-risk-committee review must approve to move a workflow up one tier.
svg.text: The Tier 0-3 ladder (JPMorgan, Goldman, BofA, BlackRock convergence, 2023-26)

g.text: Binding decisions: trade execution / credit underwriting / settlement / fraud-block
No LLM in the loop, pure deterministic logic, validated under SR 11-7
Drafting assistant: internal memos, first-draft client comms, code review
Mandatory human review of every output before external release; audit log keeps draft + final
Grounded retrieval: compliance research, policy lookup, BlackRock Aladdin
Cite source, refuse-on-uncertainty, spot-check 5-25%, every answer auditable
Customer-facing: BofA Erica, Capital One Eno
Real-time scope guardrails + topic classifier + escalation path + red-teaming
"What binding action does the output influence, and how many humans stand between?"
Framework first articulated at Goldman Sachs, late 2023; reproduced in JPMorgan risk-mgmt white paper 2024.
